Questions

When do I get all 25?
[N] are in your download today. About 5 more are added every day until all 25 are in. [DATE WORDING + how buyers get each update: your OK]
Can I do it all on my phone?
[CONFIRM after the CapCut test: what needs a computer (install) and what works on a phone (edit, post)]
How do I edit the carousel?
Open its Canva link (a free account works), swap the photos and type over the [brackets].
Is music included?
No. The Reels have no audio: no music and no sound effects. Add a sound in Instagram after you upload, so your Reel never gets muted.
Do I need to install fonts?
No, they come with the template.
How do I change the words?
Double-click a text box and type.
My computer warns me about the installer.
That is normal. Click More info, then Run anyway.
Can I swap a clip?
Yes. Right-click it on the timeline and choose Replace.
Do I need CapCut Pro or Canva Pro?
No. The templates open in free CapCut and the carousels in free Canva. [CONFIRM: no Pro features, from the CapCut test of all 25]

Listing description

25 Reel templates for CapCut, made for shops that sell physical products: packing videos, before and afters, gift guides, unboxings, reviews, tests, new drops and more. Film a few clips on your phone, drop them in a folder and double-click the installer: the template opens in CapCut with your clips in place. Type your words over the brackets and export. Each template comes with a shot list, a recipe card, a one-page guide, a phone kit and a matching Instagram carousel you can edit free in Canva. Each one suggests a sound to add in Instagram (no sound files included).

Demo footage to film

Film the demos as two example shops, a soap shop and a T-shirt store, using real products of those kinds, run through the real installer. Never the after.mp4 previews (they show other brands' products). Also film the how-to video for the How it works section. The full shot list for each template is in its zip.
